items.title: Diane Swonk Calls Inflation the Most Regressive Tax. Retirees on Fixed Incomes Feel It First
items.summary: A retiree can't ask for a raise or pick up extra shifts, and the one adjustment they get each year follows someone else's spending. One number in your budget decides how hard inflation hits, and most retirees never calculate it.

items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Backs $270 Million Stablecoin Push With Project Faro
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS), Citigroup, and several large banks are committing $270m to launch a new stablecoin project called Project Faro. Project Faro is designed as a U.S. dollar pegged stablecoin targeting both institutional clients and retail users across global markets. The consortium aims to compete directly with established crypto native stablecoins within a digital asset sector estimated at about $290b.
